'''Zevanth Street''' was a street that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] chef [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] first arrived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he opened the stand [[Dex's Donuts]] on the corner of Zevanth Street and [[Avenue Peth]].<ref name="Dex" />
